shortDescription: Peru's monthly consumer prices rose 0.57% in October, according to data published on Sunday by the national statistics agency INEI, marking the biggest monthly increase for October in over four years.

children: Peru's monthly consumer prices rose 0.57% in October, according to data published on Sunday by the national statistics agency INEI, marking the biggest monthly increase for October in over four years.
The 10-month cumulative change through October reached 4.88%, with an annual rate of 5.25% from November 2025 to October 2026
The increase was driven by food and non-alcoholic beverages, which rose 1.62%, and transport costs, which climbed 0.77%
Food price increases were led by the fish and seafood sector, which climbed 11.7%, alongside vegetables like corn, which rose 45.3%, and carrots, up 24.6%
At the national level, consumer prices increased 0.56% in October, with all 26 monitored cities reporting price increases
Core inflation, excluding food and energy, rose 0.16% in October
October's increase follows the 0.12% rise seen in September
